input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent UI control atlas for a portrait Cocos Creator slot-machine cabinet
Primary request: create exactly four original physical casino cabinet controls in one precisely aligned 2-column by 2-row square atlas, matching a warm burgundy, champagne-gold, ivory-enamel and pearl luxury slot machine
Subject/order: top-left: a large front-facing circular SPIN plunger with a convex ivory-gold center, thick polished champagne-gold rim, thin burgundy glass ring and small pearl highlights, completely blank; top-right: a horizontal dual BET rocker module with two clearly separated round burgundy push wells mounted in one ivory-enamel and gold base, completely blank; bottom-left: an AUTO control shaped as a luminous pearl crystal orb seated in a compact gold and burgundy base, front-facing and completely blank; bottom-right: a small horizontal secondary cabinet button/plaque with a softly convex burgundy glass face, ivory enamel inset and thick champagne-gold bevel, completely blank
Style/medium: high-end polished 3D mobile slot-game control render, tactile physical buttons, realistic bevel depth, glass and enamel reflections, same friendly vintage casino cabinet language as a premium rounded patisserie-style arcade machine but with no candy motifs
Composition/framing: exact uniform 2x2 grid; one isolated centered control per cell; each control front-facing, visually balanced and fully contained with at least 12 percent clear padding; consistent scale and warm upper-left studio lighting
Lighting/mood: warm marquee glow, crisp golden edge highlights, controlled pearl sparkle, inviting casino excitement
Color palette: champagne gold, rose gold, deep warm burgundy, pearl ivory and cream; tiny emerald or ruby pin-light accents only
Materials/textures: polished and satin gold, glossy burgundy glass, ivory enamel, nacreous pearl, fine filigree
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha; no cell borders; no labels; no letters; no numbers; no plus or minus marks; no logos; no watermark; no drop shadows outside each cell; original design only
Avoid: flat vector UI, dark sci-fi controls, neon cyberpunk, black plastic, cheap yellow metal, candy, cake, food, text-like markings, malformed grid, cropped objects
